user.title: Hive Local TRV
user.description: Enter your Zigbee2MQTT base topic. TRVs are discovered automatically.

abort.already_configured: This Zigbee2MQTT instance is already configured.
abort.no_devices_available: All discovered TRVs are already assigned to room groups.

data_description.boiler_entity: Turned on or off based on TRV heat demand. Supports climate, switch, and input_boolean.
data_description.person_entities: When all selected people leave home, frost protection activates automatically.
data_description.enable_diagnostics: Writes HIVE_DIAG entries to the HA log. Useful for troubleshooting.

menu_options.edit_group: Edit a room group (add or remove members)

create_group.title: Create Room Group — Step 1 of 3
create_group.description: Enter a name for the new room group.

data_description.room_name: Display name, e.g. Living Room or Master Bedroom.

create_group_devices.title: Create Room Group — Step 2 of 3
create_group_devices.description:
Select devices for room: {room_name}

Only devices not already in another group are shown. Each device can only belong to one group.

data_description.trv_names: Select one or more TRVs or thermostats.

create_group_sensors.title: Create Room Group — Step 3 of 3
create_group_sensors.description:
Room: {room_name} with {trv_count} device(s): {trv_names}

Optionally add extra temperature sensors.

data_description.temp_sensors: Additional HA temperature sensor entities included in the room temperature average.

edit_group.title: Edit Room Group — Step 1 of 2
edit_group.description: Select the room group to edit.

edit_group_members.title: Edit Room Group — Step 2 of 2

data_description.trv_names: Tick all devices that should belong to this group. Unticked current members will be removed.

remove_group.title: Remove Room Group
remove_group.description: Select the room group to remove. Individual TRV entities are not affected.
